chapter: Dixieland, revival bands and record collectors
title: Claims of inventing jazz and readers versus improvisers
summary: Nick LaRocca and bayou musicians claimed to have invented jazz; Kid Sheik on Manuel Perez, and the meaning of 'musician' as a reader.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
